name: token-radar
description: make.fun token-radar-01 entry: a launch radar for pre-token protocols. It reads a sealed DefiLlama snapshot, ranks the protocols that record no token yet by what a launch would be worth under a fully stated arithmetic model, writes a static dashboard plus a per-protocol airdrop-farming plan, and ships everything offline — no network, no framework, no build step. Node 22+, standard library only.
